title: Break equal-order prompt section ties by name instead of registration order

source.anchor: Sections sharing an `order` value tie-break by registration order

task:
Problem: prompt sections and runtime contexts that share an `order` value are emitted in registration order. packages/core/system-prompt/src/index.ts:403 (`sections()`), :518 (assembled sections) and :538 (contexts) sort with `(a, b) => a.order - b.order` only, so plugin load order, a Loader artifact that differs between compositions and across HMR replacement, decides model-visible prompt text. The README states the gap at packages/core/system-prompt/README.md:91 and contrasts it with the tool order, which was canonicalized for exactly this reason (`compareToolNames`, index.ts:181-183).

Required: break `order` ties by `name` with the same code-point comparison `compareToolNames` uses, at all three sort sites, so an assembled prompt is a pure function of the registered set. Replace the README bullet (English and Chinese together) with the rule, mention the tie-break in the `section()` and `context()` JSDoc where `order` is documented, and re-record the pair with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write packages/core/system-prompt/README.md`. Add packages/core/system-prompt/tests/section-order-ties.spec.ts that registers two sections and two contexts with an equal `order` in reverse-name order and asserts that `sections()` and an assembled prompt place them by name.

Snapshots: run `pnpm run test:snapshot`. If any expected output changes, a shipped composition relies on a tie; stop, revert, and report the colliding section names instead of re-recording. When the suite is unchanged no snapshot update is needed because no shipped transcript is affected.

Constraints: the comparator is not an agent-loop change, so docs/architecture.md stays untouched; no Agent Note is needed for this local determinism fix.
